selection.selection: All WAV members, sorted by filename
selection.integrity: Complete archive MD5 06ebea7cc467ace800752bd21ec7178d and member CRC32

evaluation.score_alignment: Use the official 64 ms score bin containing each 50 ms target midpoint
evaluation.event_matching: Same class, positive overlap, maximum pair count then IoU; permissive, not collar F1 or PSDS
evaluation.boundary_mae: Conditional on overlap-matched pairs; exclude onsets <=0.45 s and offsets >=10 s; unmatched events counted in F1
evaluation.limitations: Public synthetic training recordings, not the old validation split. Full future context and full-window normalization. Pretraining-data overlap not audited; not an independent generalization benchmark or causal-vs-bidirectional ablation.
